issues: Metamorphic probes omit the required batch dimension: one_hot on a 3D mask produces a 4D tensor, so permute(0, 4, 1, 2, 3) will fail.
Most probes use identical prediction and reference masks, so the non-empty SurfaceDice score is 1 by construction and will not expose the representation-dependence bug.

The violated invariant incorrectly says distances are computed in voxel indices; get_surface_distance already passes spacing to distance_transform_edt, so the main issue is unweighted boundary-sample counting rather than missing distance scaling.
No 2-D probe is provided even though the acceptance checks require 2-D behavior.
suggested_fixes: Construct batch-first one-hot inputs, e.g. torch.as_tensor(mask[None, ...]) before one_hot and permute.
Use non-identical pred/ref pairs with a fixed physical offset or shape difference, then compare scores across resampled, permuted, or anisotropically scaled representations.
Revise the invariant to state that directed distances are already physical in the Euclidean path, but boundary samples are counted without physical length/area weights.
Add at least one 2-D batch-first probe to verify edge-length weighting and representation consistency.
